rationale: The production roadmap requires a single MemoryPlane write source with project scope, provenance and Evidence Spine linkage so global memory and project-specific views do not become conflicting sources of truth. This change introduces a canonical MemoryPlane service, public hooks and API routes for durable memory writes and project-scoped search. It is D3 because it adds a public memory write contract and persistent memory_entries table that future modules must use as the source of truth.

steps: Revert memory/plane.py and the public hook exports in memory/__init__.py.
Revert /api/v1/memory/plane routes and stats aggregation changes.
Run memory, retrieval, indexer, evidence store and API integration tests twice.
Leave any existing memory_entries rows inert; do not delete production memory data during rollback.

fidelity_test.description: Verify that canonical memory writes require provenance, create evidence links, index content with project_id and return project-scoped search results.
pre_conditions: Memory stores are reset and bootstrapped against a shared SQLite database.
Evidence Spine and Indexer are available to MemoryPlane.
FastAPI memory routes are available through the test client.
steps: Write two memory entries with the same searchable term but different project_id values.
Verify each entry has entry_id, evidence_id, provenance, metadata and content_hash.
Verify the Evidence Spine artifact for the auto-created evidence_id exists.
Search by query with project_id and confirm only that project's entry is returned.
Use /api/v1/memory/plane/write, search, project view, entry fetch and stats endpoints.
Run the broad memory/API test suite twice.
fidelity_test.expected_outcome: All new canonical memory writes carry provenance.source and evidence_id, are indexed by project_id, and project-scoped search does not leak entries across projects.
